name: A Scheme to Provide Free Tablets to Std.12th Pass Students
benefit: - Under the scheme, students in the 12th standard belonging to the Scheduled Caste category will receive a tablet by paying a token fee of ₹1,000/-.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant should have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC/Std. 12) examination. 1. The applicant should be admitted to the first year of a graduate-level course in a recognized university.
